doc.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Studio dates with Ogerman, Sebesky and Sammy Nestico
summary: He played Nestico dates when Nestico came to Canada, where Morell lived 25 years.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: I was going to say boy, you played with him and you played with Don Sebesky, who is one of my favorite writers. Cool.
Yeah. I did a lot of dates with, we’re playing one of his charts, Sammy Nestico.

Yeah he used to come up – I lived in, you probably know I lived in Canada for about 25 years and he used to come up to do projects up there, and fortunately he always asked for me in the rhythm section, so that was pretty nice. And I did a lot of dates and sessions with Sammy. Sammy is a great writer. Amazing writer.
Yeah. He’s a sweetheart. He’s still active, he’s like 92 or 93 or something, still writing. It’s amazing.
